answer: A payout is split thus 24% arrives at settlement and the rest over 4 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The sparrow schedule is applied in harbor and nebula exposes each instalment. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3389 identities would post 3192 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
